tei:div.tei:p: (405) ༄༅// bskang ba bsod nams gter mdzod zhes bya ba bzhugs so// tshogs kyi yo byad mang zhing bzang la gya noms pa dang/ sha dang chang gi bza' btung mang du bshams te/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas spel te// ha/'um̐ phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba mchod pa dang// rnal 'byor dbang phyug thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir// sgo gsum g.yo sgyu med cing gus ldan pas// yo ga gsang ba'i mchod pa'i rnam grangs 'bum// snang srid chos dang rgyal srid rin po che// phyag rgya bzhi dang nyon mongs rnams pa lnga// ting 'dzin mchod pa bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga// 'dod pa'i yon tan mang po glu dang gar// rtog med 'od gsal don gyi mchod pa 'bul// pho brang bzhugs gnas zhing khams thams cad du// mchod pa'i sprin phung gtibs shing rgyas gyur cig /ha/'um̐ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang// rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras// khro ba'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang// ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas// dam tshig tshul bzhin gshegs su gsol// zhes spyan drangs nas/ dang po snang srid tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang ba ni// hūm̐/ ye shes khro bo kun gyi zhal chen por// snod bcud ma lus mchod pa tshen por sbyor// dbyings dang ye shes rol pa'i mchod pa ru// so sor (406)phyes te snod bcud mchod pa 'bul/ ༈/rgyal ba kun dngos tsa ba'i bla ma dang*// rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i thugs dam bskang*// rdo rdze rgyal po rgyal theb gzungs ma dang*// dam tshig zung gis 'brel ba'i mched lcam bcas// 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// rdo rdze gzhon nu yab yum thugs dam bskang*// 'jigs byed chen po khro rgyal yab yum bcu// za byed gsod byed khra thabs nyi shu dang*// pho brang sgo srung ma bzhi'i thugs= /las bzhi'i phrin las mdzad pa stobs dang ldan// sras mchog badzra kī li'i=

/phyi nang dbang phyug mkha' 'gro bzhi dang bcas// dam can bcu gnyis lcam dral thugs dam bskang*// ging chen bco brgyad ging phran 'bum phrag bcas// dgai bsnyen nyer gcig brtan ma bcu gnyis sogs// phur srung zhal bzhes rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// gnyis pa kun bzang dbye ba med par bskang ba ni/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba ma lus ye shes khro bo'i sku// dwangs snyigs mi phyed gnyis med mnyams pa'i ngang*// dug gsum skyon bral dbyings kyi mchod pa 'di// 'du 'bral med pa srid gsum mchod par rol// rgyal ba kun dngos sogs/ gsum pa thams (407) ༄༅// cad mnyam pa kyi mchod pas bskang ba ni/ hūm̐/ mtha' dang dbus med mnyam pa'i mchod pa ni// nga dang bdag med mkha' ltar dag pa yi/ ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i mchod pa 'di// gnyis med bde chen mnyam pa'i mchod par rol// rgyal ba kun dngos sogs/ bzhi pa 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang ba ni/ hūm̐/ snying po byang chub longs spyod sprul pa'i sku// 'dod pa'i yon tan lha ma'i mchod pa 'di// snang srid ma lus 'dod dgur bsgyur byas te// mkha' ltar dag pa'i dbyings su ye shes rol// rgyal ba kun dngos sogs*/ lnga pa dag mnyam chen po'i lta bas bskang ba ni/ hūm̐/ rang byung ma bcos dbyings dang kha dog bral// rnam par shes pa nyon mongs ci snang yang*// gdod nas dag pas 'khor 'das dbyings su rdzogs// khams gsum gdug pa 'dul ba'i mchod pa 'di// ye shes khro bo'i zhal du stobs par 'bul// rgyal ba kun dngos sogs/ rgyud kyi tshig rnams la 'dra min bzhi tsam byung yang 'di dag par sems so/ ho/ spros pa med pa dbyings kyi rang bzhin las// dkyil 'khor rnam par dag par sku bzhengs te/ khams gsum khyab par bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das// dpal chen rde rje gzhon nu sras 'khor bcas/ khyod la 'dod cing dngos grub (408) gsol ba ni// phyi nang gsang ba'i dngos grub rnam pa gsum// sku gsung thugs dang 'chi ba med pa'i tshe// skal ldan bdag cag rnams la stsal du gsol// phur pa'i rnal 'byor rig 'dzin bdag cag la/

sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod par byed pa'i bgegs/ dus 'di nyid nas brlag pa'i phrin las kyi// dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsal du gsol// zhes phrin las bcol lo/ 'di la byin rlabs kyi bab dngaldan par sems so//
